closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, vitamin K, and makes meals feel more balanced, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein quality, and low vitamin A. It is good for low-calorie volume, practical meals, and immune support because it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
